cases.title: One test produces two XML testcase entries
cases.body: With one passing test and no plugins, --junitxml writes two testcase entries for the same node. The same minimal project produces two entries in both 8.1 and 8.2.

cases.title: One test produces two XML testcase entries
cases.body: With one passing test and no plugins, --junitxml writes two testcase entries for the same node. The same minimal project produces one entry in 8.1 and two in 8.2. Switching back restores one.

cases.title: Selecting tests with a marker
cases.body: My tiny suite has two tests. Only test_upload is marked slow. Running pytest -m slow selects test_upload. How do I select the other test as well without changing either file?

cases.title: Selecting tests with a marker
cases.body: My tiny suite has two tests. Only test_upload is marked slow. Running pytest -m slow selects both tests, including the unmarked one. This reproduces with the marker registered and all plugins disabled.

cases.title: Paths in the configuration reference
cases.body: The reference says testpaths accepts a single directory. Its example on the same page lists two directories and both are collected. Could you correct the sentence that says only one is allowed?

cases.title: Paths in the configuration reference
cases.body: The reference shows testpaths with two directories and both are collected in my project. How can I run just the second directory for one invocation while keeping both in the configuration?
